4．2 各方法建立和评价的基本思路
Methods in analysis of the dynamics of drug interaction and its software CoDrug
ZHENG Qing-Shan SUN Ru-i Yuan（Anhui Provincial Center for Drug Clinical EvaluationYijishan Hospital of Wannan Medical CollegeWuhu 241001）ABSTRACT In clinical and experimental therapeutics the quantitative analysis of drug interaction will supply a tool for optimizing and evaluating a combination in the study of compound drugthe design of combination drug therapyand the evaluation of traditional medicine formulae．This paper listed the systematic methods of the quantitative analysis including the weighted modification method for optimizing constituentsdoses and ratio in combinationthe parameter method and the reflection method for dynamic analysis of drug interactionand a comprehensive method for multiple response indexes·The software CoDrug about these methods also was introduced KEY WORDS drug interaction；
